messages:
sara: early handoff — primary is me until 14:30 PT. current notes: watch for p99 latency regressions from the last deploy, several p50 spikes seen overnight. runbook links below.

incident-bot: Pager triggered: inference-serving latency_p99 > 1.2s (region: us-west-2). 3 alerts in last 10m. PagerID: PGR-8712.

michael: on it — i'm primary on-call coverage for compute until 15:00 PT if you need escalation. any affected customers called out?

sara: no direct customer pages yet but internal telemetry shows increased retry rates for embeddings and some 5xx for chat endpoints. per-tenant graph shows a spike confined to a few medium tenants (tag: high-throughput).

omar: adding quick checklist: 1) confirm KV cache pressure, 2) check pod restarts, 3) check autoscale events. runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/inference/kv-cache-fallback

priya: +1 on KV cache. last deploy changed cache retention flags. suspect eviction storm. also watch token batching latency.

michael: running quick checks: `kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=runtime -o wide` -> seeing 3/9 pods restart_count > 2 on us-west-2-prod.

opsbot: autoscaler event: scale-up triggered for runtime-pool-usw2 at 2025-11-12T13:41:22Z, reason: increased queue length.

omar: can we temporarily pin traffic to a stable variant? recommend routing small % to model-variant v1.2-stable. if that works, fallback the rest. config snippet:
```
route policy set inference-route --region us-west-2 --percent 10 --model v1.2-stable
```

sara: good idea. @michael do the route switch and monitor error rate for 5m. if errors drop, increment to 30% then 100% as safe.

michael: doing 10% now. `route-policy apply` succeeded.

priya: watching logs — error rate down 40% from the problematic tenants. latency p99 still elevated for remaining traffic.

omar: next quick mitigation if pinning helps: clear local KV cache on misbehaving pods to force warm restarts. command: `curl -X POST http://localhost:9001/admin/cache/clear` on affected pods.

michael: running curl on pod runtime-5: returned 200. restarting pod to pick new kernel config. `kubectl rollout restart deployment/runtime -n inference --field-selector metadata.name=runtime-5`

incident-bot: Update: Pager PGR-8712 — mitigation in progress, status: acknowledged, owners: michael, omar.

sara: prioritization notes for handoff — when you take primary next, check: 1) routing policy (% to v1.2-stable), 2) pod restart counts, 3) autoscaler logs, 4) customer ticket queue for affected tenants. Keep DNR (do not rollback full deploy) unless regressions widen.

michael: quick customer-impact summary for handoff: 3 medium tenants saw intermittent 5xx, estimated 5–10% of their requests retried. no major enterprise outages. I opened ticket OPS-3491 for outreach.

priya: adding runbook links: fallback routing doc: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/inference/routing-fallbacks; restart playbook: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/inference/restart-playbook; pager triage checklist: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/oncall/pager-triage. put those in your pocket for the shift.

omar: if you pick this up as primary, short checklist to follow in order:
- confirm traffic split (route-policy show)
- watch p99 and 5xx for 5m windows
- clear cache on one pod and observe
- restart pod if cache clear alone doesn't drop p99
- escalate to infra if restarts >3 or autoscaler oscillation

sara: tagging handoff: i'm handing primary to michael at 14:30 PT. michael — you good to be primary for the next 2h? if not, call out now. :wave:

michael: I can take primary. i'll keep running rolling restarts at low blast and watch telemetry. if we see more than 2% increased retries across tenants, i'll open a P1 with infra.

incident-bot: Pager PGR-8712 status: mitigated for 12 minutes for pinned traffic; monitoring continues.

sara: final note for the next handoff: leave a quick summary in the incident channel and update OPS-3491 with customer outreach status. I'll follow up with a short after-action at end of shift.

michael: noted. leaving pinned route at 30% for next 20m, will hand primary to omar at 16:30 PT unless we see further regressions.

omar: copy — i'll validate autoscaler stability during my primary. thanks team. :thumbsup:
